title: I Used the Tool-Library Camera on the Member Who Hid the Oscilloscope

parts.text: I reserved the scope for 4:00 p.m. It was not on the board. A member had slid it behind the banner paper. The tool-library camera policy they had voted for said: HOLDS ON THE BOARD. HIDING IS A SUSPEND. I was thirty-two, night repair, holding a reservation slip. I asked the desk to pull the camera. The still showed the slide. They suspended the member two weeks. I scoped a power supply that finally had a channel. Hiding, it turns out, is a vote you can lose.
